rules.bar_availability: next weekday after the session, 00:00 America/Sao_Paulo
rules.security_id: ISIN (CODISI); a new ISIN is a new security_id
rules.identity_primary: CVM FCA valor_mobiliario Codigo_Negociacao used by the ISIN -> CNPJ; effective_on = Data_Inicio_Negociacao (else DT_REFER); available_at = DT_RECEB + 1 day; Data_Fim_Negociacao unused
